scope: Compare the already selected SERPINA1-cluster reads with public genomic clone AL117259.6 and map the clone back to the unchanged complete GRCh38 reference. Not a patient assembly or definitive locus assignment.
reference_selection: AL117259 is cited as the SERPINA2/SERPINA6 genomic sequence in Seixas et al., 2007, PMID 17135331. Current archive returns sequence version 6; old paper-relative coordinates are not assumed to match this version.
